arguments.cmd:
python3 << 'EOF'
import trimesh, numpy as np
m = trimesh.load('/tmp/lid.stl')
n = m.face_normals; c = m.triangles_center
ov = n[:,2] < -0.7071
sel = ov & (np.abs(c[:,2]-30.4)<0.01)
pts = c[sel]
print("z30.4 overhang faces:", sel.sum(), "area:", m.area_faces[sel].sum())
print("x range:", pts[:,0].min(), pts[:,0].max())
print("y range:", pts[:,1].min(), pts[:,1].max())
# histogram over x in bins of 2
xs = np.floor(pts[:,0]/2)*2
import collections
cnt = collections.Counter(xs)
for k in sorted(cnt): print(f"  x~{k}: {cnt[k]} faces")
# histogram over y
ys = np.floor(pts[:,1]/2)*2
cnt = collections.Counter(ys)
for k in sorted(cnt): print(f"  y~{k}: {cnt[k]} faces")
EOF
